note: C-37/C-26 attested provenance chain. Every SHIPPED production component (what GitHub Pages serves) is listed with its content hash and the chain that produced it: the frozen specification it derives from, the policy bundle that gated it, the test evidence, the adversarial-verification result, and the NAMED OWNING ROLE answerable for it. verify/tests/61-provenance verifies (a) every shipped file is listed, (b) each hash matches the file on disk (a silent change to a shipped component breaks the chain and fails the build), and (c) the chain fields are non-empty. This is git-anchored and machine-reconstructible on demand. RESIDUAL (R-LEDGER, honest): the model+prompt-hash per commit is NOT cryptographically signed here; git history + this manifest are the append-only substitute. Full Runner-only signed provenance is the buildable upgrade. | v2.1 (compiled-ahead): served set is index.html + compiled ./*.js + self-hosted ./vendor/* ; the .jsx are attested SOURCE, and 66-compiled-fresh proves compiled==source. | v2.2 (module migration): sources under src/ (data as JSON, esbuild bundle); .jsx removed; data hash unchanged.

components.adversarial_verification: A 27-agent review panel over the real screenshots and the source confirmed six defects AFTER the first merge, all fixed here: HS.card had overflow:hidden without minHeight:0 so grid children could not shrink and the r2 cards overran their track at 1280x800; the scroll fade was unconditional and ghosted the final row of live data; the weight gutter sat on the <th> only, so the header hung ~15px off its column and values collided with the bar; gauge captions were <text> inside a meet-scaled SVG (~6px at 1280, oversized at 1920) and are now HTML at fixed size; the chart reserved 55-60% of its plot for a band the score has never reached; and the legend separated label from value by up to 640px with nothing between. Built and screenshotted in headless Chromium at 1280x800 / 1440x900 / 1920x1080 and iterated four times against those images; then reviewed by an independent three-lens panel (visual craft / number honesty / a11y+robustness) over the same screenshots and the source. Defects found and fixed this way: section mounted 324px down and inside the 1060px column; clipped y-axis numerals; gauge overflowing its card so the legend was swallowed by overflow:hidden; sparklines reading a live.series field the feed does not expose; a table row sliced at 800px height; and a "VIX" legend showing multiplier/2 as a percentage. Verified in a real browser, NOT only by static render.
